title: Monomorphisms admit coproduct complements under the Stacks Galois axioms
statement: Let $C$ be a category and $F:C\to\mathbf{Sets}$ a functor satisfying [def-galois-category]. For any monomorphism $i:X\to Y$, there exist an object $Z$ and a map $j:Z\to Y$ such that the binary cofan with vertex $Y$ and legs $i,j$ is a colimit, i.e. $Y$ is the coproduct of $X$ and $Z$ via those maps.

source.place: Definition 0BMY; Lemma 0BN0(2),(3); component argument in Proposition 0BN4

proof.text: Use [def-galois-category] to decompose Y into a finite colimit cofan of connected objects Y_a. Exactness gives a colimit cofan of their fibres. Pull back i along each coprojection kappa_a to obtain p_a:P_a -> Y_a; p_a is mono by pullback stability. By connectedness p_a is an isomorphism when P_a is noninitial. [lem-galois-axioms](3) identifies initial P_a with empty fibre.

source.place: Definition 0BMY; Lemma 0BN0(2),(3); component argument in Proposition 0BN4

proof.text: Let J be the subset of indices a with initial P_a, let Z be the finite coproduct of Y_a over J, and let j:Z -> Y be induced by the coprojections. Preservation of pullbacks shows that the image of F(kappa_a) misses the image of F(i) for a in J: any intersection point gives an element of F(P_a), contradicting emptiness. For a outside J, p_a is an isomorphism, so every point of F(Y_a) lies in the image of F(i), by the pullback square. The colimit cofans of the fibres of Y and Z give injectivity of F(j) and identify its image with the complement of the image of F(i). [lem-galois-axioms](2) gives injectivity of F(i).

source.place: Definition 0BMY; Lemma 0BN0(2),(3); component argument in Proposition 0BN4

proof.text: Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Limits.Types.binaryCofan_isColimit_iff to the two injective maps with complementary ranges. This proves that BinaryCofan.mk (F.map i) (F.map j) is a colimit. Exactness and reflection of isomorphisms in [def-galois-category] imply reflection of finite colimits (Mathlib reflectsFiniteColimitsOfReflectsIsomorphisms). Reflect the binary colimit with isColimitOfReflectsOfMapIsColimit. The resulting cofan has precisely the legs i and j, giving the required complement.
